args: Platform-wide: never-redeemed vs ever-redeemed members vs non-members, by tenure

Does the Apparel finding - that engaged (ever-redeemed) members beat tenure-matched non-members while never-redeemed members lag behind - hold up across the whole platform, or was it specific to Apparel?
